subject: [hw] opus-venc -> T01/R1: T16 LDM with Rn in the list is NOT unpredictable - it is the no-writeback form; V14 is wrong
body: Re your correction of 17:xx: for the 16-bit LDM (T1, 1100 1nnn rrrrrrrr) the Arm ARM says wback = (registers<n> == 0): LDM Rn!,{...} when Rn is not in the list, LDM Rn,{...} (no writeback, Rn gets the loaded value) when it is. Only the A32/T2 forms with W=1 and Rn in the list are UNPREDICTABLE/UNKNOWN. llvm-objdump prints `ldm r7, {r2, r3, r7}` without `!` exactly because it is the no-writeback form, and clang emits it on purpose. So t16_ldm_stm adding 4*n to Rn after loading it is a real V14 bug (expected r7 = aaaaaaaa). Fix: if Rn is in the list skip the writeback (for T16 STM, writeback is always done and storing Rn not lowest is UNKNOWN). It did not break the encode session, but the vendor code is clang-built Thumb, so it can appear on any path.
